A page is served only when it and every page above it (by `parent_id`) are visible: public, or preview too with the preview token. `hide_start_links` is set when the page's `start` sub-page is not. A bare `/<slug>` with no page of its own redirects (301) to the one visible page with that slug.

put.description: Requires an employee session, the editor's Origin header and the editor role (403 otherwise). Send every field: a save replaces the page and defaults none, except that leaving `parent_id` out keeps the page's parent. Send the `updated_at` you last read in the `if-updated-at` header. If the stored row, or the page's pending revision, has moved on since, the save is refused with a 409 rather than silently discarding whoever wrote first. Changing `url` moves this page alone: its sub-pages keep their urls and stay beneath it by `parent_id`, and nothing redirects from the old url. Changing `visibility` needs the approver role (403 otherwise). Making a page public is refused (403) to an approver who changed its content since it was last public, in this save or before: another approver makes it public. A save that keeps a `public` page public, whoever sends it, goes into the page's pending revision: citizens keep seeing the live page until an approver publishes it. An approver's save that takes a `public` page out of public view changes only its `visibility`: the other fields sent are ignored, the live content stays, and the page's open revision is discarded: a draft is dropped, and one waiting for review is closed as `discarded`, which the page's history records. A save to a page whose revision is waiting for review updates that revision, which stays waiting; the saver joins its `contributors`, so may not approve it. Such a save needs `if-updated-at` (428 without it). Returns the page as the editor now works on it.

get.description: `change_events` records every page and category change, and each review step of a page's revision. Its count and newest timestamp identify those changes without reading the content.

post.summary: Submit a page's draft revision for review
post.description: Needs the editor role (403 otherwise). Records the submitter, who may not then approve it. 404 when the page has no draft revision; 409 `under_review` when it is already submitted, or `conflict` when the draft has been saved since `if-updated-at`. Saves made while it waits update it, and it keeps waiting. A rejected revision can be submitted again as it is: it is copied into a new submitted revision with the same `updated_at`, and the rejected one keeps its comment. The copy's `contributors` gain the rejected round's submitter, who may not approve it either.

post.summary: Reject a submitted revision with a comment
post.description: Needs the approver role, and the approver must not have changed or submitted the revision (403 otherwise). The live page is unchanged; the revision is kept with the comment, and the next save starts a new draft from it. Rejecting moves the revision's `updated_at`, so an editor holding the earlier one reloads and sees why. `if-updated-at` is required (428 without it). 404 when nothing is waiting for review; 409 `not_submitted` for a draft, or `conflict` when the revision is no longer the version in `if-updated-at`.

post.summary: Approve a submitted revision and publish it
post.description: Needs the approver role, and the approver must not have changed or submitted the revision (403 otherwise). Writes the revision to the live page as a save would, re-indexes it and records the approver in `change_events`, all in one transaction. A revision that has gone stale while it waited (its parent or category gone, or its url taken) is refused with a 422 naming the field, and nothing changes. `if-updated-at` is required (428 without it). 404 when nothing is waiting for review; 409 `not_submitted` for a draft, or `conflict` when the revision is no longer the version in `if-updated-at`. Returns the page as it now stands.
